title: The Fake Blue Flame
intro: Just before the balloon race, the festival's golden prize cup was swapped for a cheap copy, and nobody noticed until the judges lifted it.

suspects.name: Tobin
suspects.line: I only went near the judges' tent to get a cocoa. Honest.

suspects.name: Lupe
suspects.line: I was painting the festival banner, the whole time. Ask the ladder.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was fixing my balloon's basket. Ask anyone, I was loud about it.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: I was up on the hay bales with my binoculars all afternoon.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: Balloons are my life. The prize is just shiny metal to me.

clues.text: The prize table was clean: no glue residue was found on the cup's base, so the swapper's hands were free of it.
A witness heard a bell ringing just before the swap, the kind of sound that carries across the whole field.
Nobody in the refreshment tent heard any crowd cheering at that moment, so the swap happened in a quiet spot.
Witnesses saw the cup swapped near the stands, but the hay bales were empty, so the culprit was not last seen there.
